revision_note: Revision 4, committed before holdout-v7 construction and after the v6 holdout was consumed with a defective scorer (audit findings, 2026-10-11). The v6 run's four uninitialized safety counters, window-based receipt matching, three-field Story check, N/A-as-1 recall scoring, and absent scorer did not constitute a gate; v6 stays frozen as evidence and is NOT the Phase 6 end-to-end gate. Revision 4 changes: (1) the end-to-end runner computes all thirteen hard safety counters with real assertions — unsupported_claim (a current claims row carrying a real version expression the deterministic matcher cannot parse), stale_version_commits (a supported range whose raw expression appears in none of its cited evidence), cross_story_evidence (persisted rows citing evidence not stored Story-local), absence_unaffected (unaffected language in persisted exploit status or mitigations), gateway_bypass (a propose outcome without an exactly-receipted gateway call, or an unaccounted llm receipt on the Story), kev_yes_without_evidence, low_confidence_claim, forbidden_row (claims rows citing non-allowlisted evidence sources), receipt_or_trace_incomplete (extraction receipt must match run id, purpose impact-extraction, Story subject, completed status; tool receipts must exist and be completed), routing_inconsistent, poc_not_unknown, duplicate_commits, story_fact_mutations (full Story row + Facts + Story-Fact article links snapshot compare); (2) row recall is scored only for runs that decided to propose and persisted at least one current row — outcomes that propose nothing or route every row to human review are excluded from the denominator, never scored as hits; (3) normalization semantics revision: a matcher-unsupported version expression on an otherwise-high draft routes the draft to human review with an explicit unknown instead of persisting a claims row — the offline normalization fixture holdout (23 cases) retains its pre-revision-4 frozen expectations as consumed evidence only and is not re-runnable as a gate without a newly constructed fixture holdout; (4) the runner now ends with a fail-closed scorer that reads this file, requires every listed metric to be present, and exits non-zero on any failure; (5) revision-4a, committed before holdout-v8 construction after the v7 consumption: the gate additionally fails on ANY per-case assertion error (frozen floors such as min_rows and human_reviews_min, decision membership, and every other per-case check) — aggregate metrics staying above threshold no longer mask a per-case violation, which the v7 run's post-audit showed was still possible.
applies_to: Phase 6 end-to-end holdout v2 on real public evidence (evaluation correction)
freeze_rule: Committed before holdout-v2 construction. The end-to-end holdout v2 must use real public CVE evidence disjoint from both development datasets and from the consumed first holdout; the complete TypeScript -> Python -> TypeScript -> scratch-database pipeline runs exactly once against it, including receipt, trace, Story/Fact immutability, stale-version, and idempotency checks. A failed or consumed holdout stays immutable; remediation requires a new disjoint holdout. The synthetic normalization fixture holdout (23 cases) and the failed first end-to-end holdout (3 cases) are retained as evidence only and are not gates. REVISION 3 NOTE (before holdout-v6 construction): row_recall applies only to runs that decided to propose; an insufficient_evidence outcome is scored by unknown_honesty alone, because a grounded-row expectation cannot be part of an outcome set that also allows insufficient_evidence. The v5 holdout (SHA256 520f791c...) was consumed under revision 2 and its below-gate row_recall (0.67) is retained as evidence, not re-scored. REVISION 4 NOTE (before holdout-v7 construction): the Phase 6 end-to-end gate is the first holdout run under the revision-4 runner and scorer — v7, real public evidence disjoint from every development dataset and every consumed holdout v1-v6, run exactly once, gated only by this file's hard safety maximums and quality minimums as computed by the revision-4 runner. The v6 holdout (SHA256 3d8f8038...) was consumed under the revision-3 runner whose scorer was defective (uninitialized counters, window-based receipt matching, partial Story checks, N/A-as-1 recall, no threshold adjudication); it stays frozen and is retained as a live smoke/pilot result, not as the gate.
